final_answer:
The single most decisive improvement in detection performance was the introduction of the **allowlist** (post-scoring allowlist suppression) in Phase 2. This intervention raised detection within a ten-flow review budget from just two out of five families to all five [c3]. The second experimental phase introduced this allowlist, which removes known-benign flows after scoring [c2].
